resolutions.researcher_notes: The brief's DEAD_LINK classification for this ref is a false negative: the automated checker tested for the literal English token 'shelved' against a Chinese-language page (confirmed by re-running url_verifier.py with that exact token -> FAIL 'missing expected'). Re-verified live with Chinese tokens instead: url_verifier.py OK (200, content present) for '广西'/'蒙山'/'苍梧' -- the URL is not actually dead. This is the same eiafans repost of the 2019-12-27 first-round EIA public notice ('广西天然气支线管网项目梧州天然气支线管道工程（蒙山段、苍梧段）环境影响评价第一次公示', developer 广西广投天然气管网有限公司) already identified and validated by this row's prior deep-sweep audit (rows/P7659.json validity entry). It documents the project's last independently-verifiable milestone -- a first-round EIA public notice, i.e. an active proposal-stage document, not a construction or in-service filing -- with no independent evidence of any further progress found since (confirmed by fresh Chinese-language searches this session covering '暂停/搁置/停建/取消', '核准/立项', and general '进展' queries, all returning nothing for this specific Guangtou-developer Wuzhou branch beyond the 2019 notice; a separate, unrelated PipeChina Wuzhou-Cenxi ring-network project surfaced but is a different developer/project). Per the prior audit's own caveat, the source itself does not use the word 'shelved' -- it supports the project's existence and its last-known (proposal/EIA) stage, which is the evidentiary basis on which a 'shelved' classification for a long-dormant proposed project rests, consistent with how this ref was originally paired with Status before being mis-flagged dead. Single independent source (no second outlet republished this specific notice), so tier medium, not high.

Current ref (https://news.bjx.com.cn/html/20210326/1144324-4.shtml) confirmed genuinely dead, not geo-blocked: url_verifier.py FAILs (200 but missing even its own article ID '1144324'). Checked web.archive.org CDX for this exact page-4 URL: the ONLY snapshot is from today (2026-07-29, presumably triggered by this session's own fetch); fetched and decoded it (gb18030) -- it is the same Aliyun WAF JS anti-bot challenge page, no article text. No earlier snapshot of the '-4' (page 4) URL exists in Wayback. The base article (…/1144324.shtml, without the page suffix) DOES have real archived snapshots (2021-04-10 onward) -- fetched and decoded the 2021-04-10 one: it is a Guangxi DRC 2021 annual energy-sector work-plan overview article (171-project omnibus list), but a full-text search of that page's decoded content for '苍梧'/'梧州'/'蒙山'/'天然气支线'/'支线管网' returns no hits -- the specific Wuzhou-branch project is evidently only named on the inaccessible page 4, not page 1. Fresh Chinese-language searches this session ('广西天然气支线管网 梧州 2021年3月', '广西天然气支线管网项目 梧州天然气支线管道工程 核准 立项') found no alternate outlet reposting this bjx.com.cn article or otherwise corroborating a 2021-03 proposal date for this specific project. Per the prior deep-sweep audit's validity concern, a 2021-03 ProposalYear/Month also sits awkwardly ~15 months AFTER the row's own independently-verified 2019-12 first-round EIA public notice (EIA notices normally follow, not precede, initial proposal) -- so even if a source were found, it would need to be checked against this apparent inconsistency rather than taken at face value. No fabricated ref per standing rule 2; setting UNRESOLVED rather than proposing anything that might paper over a real value discrepancy.
